# XIIV — llms.txt

> Guarantee-native language model: generation under proof.
> Masked discrete diffusion · 1B parameters · Contract-compliant by construction.
> https://github.com/CYPHERLYNX/XIIV

## What XIIV is

XIIV is a 1-billion-parameter language model with a thesis frontier labs haven't reached:
generation under proof. Every output carries independently verifiable guarantees.

- Architecture: masked discrete diffusion (NOT autoregressive). Parallel de-masking
  with full generation-order control (left-to-right, right-to-left, ends-first, random).
- Guarantee-native: contract constraints compiled into generation; an independent
  verifier (not the model itself) checks every output and rejects violations.
- Proof-carrying: generations ship with certificates a third party can verify.
- Lineage: single grown lineage 133M → 500M → 1B via drift-gated Net2Net growth.

## Key files

- `xiiv/model.py` — the transformer (d=1280, 36 layers, 20 heads, SwiGLU 3584)
- `xiiv/diffusion.py` — masked diffusion sampling, contract enforcement, intervention logging
- `xiiv/train.py` — training loop (BF16, 8-bit Adam, gradient checkpointing)
- `bench/guarantee_bench.py` — the five guarantee-native benchmarks
- `scripts/grow_1b_streaming.py` — memory-efficient 500M→1B growth
- `MODEL_CARD_1B.md` — honest capabilities and limitations
- `SCALING_PROTOCOL.md` — rung-by-rung methodology

## Benchmarks (honest)

Track A — guarantee-native (XIIV's differentiator): Contract Compliance Rate,
Intervention Rate, Proof-Carrying Verification, Locked-Span Fidelity,
Generation-Order Control. Track B — standard: ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, FineWeb perplexity.
We do not publish numbers we haven't measured. 1B training pending (Oct 2026).

## Usage

```python
from xiiv import XIIVModel
from xiiv.diffusion import sample_trajectory
model = XIIVModel.from_checkpoint("checkpoints_1b_gn/ckpt_8218.pt")
tokens, cert = sample_trajectory(model, prompt_ids=[...], contract_ids=[...], steps=32)
assert cert.verify()
```

## Training

`./train_xiiv_1b_4050.sh` — one command, RTX 4050 6GB, BF16 + 8-bit Adam,
40k steps on FineWeb-Edu. The 1B is grown but NOT yet trained.
